name: flow
description: One skill, /flow:setup: explores a repo, proposes improvements, grills you over a workflow design tree, then writes the repo's own spec-first, test-first loop under .claude/ (grill, spec, tickets, implement, implement-spec, review with per-repo reviewers, fix, pr, research, retro) from reference recipes. No template engine, no runtime config; every file is the repo's to edit.
